title: Ful Medames with Tahini Drizzle
summary: Fava beans simmered with garlic, cumin and tahini, finished with a lemony tahini drizzle and parsley.

ingredients.item: x 400 g cans fava beans (one left with its liquid, one drained)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Pound the garlic and cumin together to a rough paste.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Cook the beans (with the liquid from one can), water, 3 tbsp tahini and the paste over medium heat 8-10 min, stirring, until saucy.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add the 2 tbsp lemon juice and crush a few beans against the pan.

steps.title: Drizzle
steps.text: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water and salt for the drizzle until smooth and pourable.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Zig-zag the drizzle over the beans, then add the olive oil and parsley.

tips: Add the drizzle water a spoon at a time until it flows.
Crush only a few beans so most stay whole.
Serve with flatbread and sliced tomato.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
